Overview

Teresina is a city in PI with a population of 871,126. The only northeastern capital not on the coast, known for its intense heat, riverside setting, and the Parque Nacional da Serra da Capivara nearby. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 270 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
